fact: The Director General of Digital Transformation says a Prime Minister circular directs actors to favour national hosting and that the 2021 data protection law requires a special derogation to host health data abroad, so that requests are reviewed for where data is hosted.
title: Burkina : « Le crédo actuellement, c’est l’hébergement national pour des questions de souveraineté », Teg-Wendé Idriss Tinto, DG de la Transformation digitale
